profile: Viridian Therapeutics discovers, develops, and commercializes medicines for autoimmune and rare diseases, with a focus on thyroid eye disease. Its marketed product, Lumvoa (veligrotug-vvze), is an IGF-1R antagonist approved for TED. The company is advancing investigational elegrobart for TED, VRDN-008, a half-life-extended FcRn inhibitor, and a TSHR-targeting program for other autoimmune diseases.
